name: BotSieve – Bot & Fake Traffic Detector
author: custonis

sections.description:
BotSieve helps website owners understand incoming traffic more clearly.

Most analytics tools count all requests equally, including crawlers, scanners and suspicious traffic.
BotSieve focuses on traffic quality and provides a simple overview of what is happening on your website.

The plugin analyzes incoming requests and classifies them into categories such as:

  • Real visitors
  • Crawlers and bots
  • Suspicious requests

The dashboard provides:

  • Traffic quality overview
  • Top detected bots
  • Suspicious activity monitoring
  • Grouped request activity
  • Simple visual traffic distribution

BotSieve is useful for:

  • Website owners
  • SEO professionals
  • Lead generation websites
  • Security-conscious site operators
  • Anyone interested in cleaner traffic insights

Features

  • Traffic Quality Overview (last 24 hours)
  • Detection of known crawlers and bots
  • Suspicious request detection
  • Top Bots overview
  • Grouped activity monitoring
  • Lightweight dashboard UI
  • No external API calls
  • No third-party tracking
  • Local data storage only
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin
  3. Open “BotSieve” in the WordPress dashboard
sections.faq:
Does BotSieve block bots?

No. BotSieve focuses on traffic analysis and detection.

Does the plugin affect performance?

BotSieve is lightweight and designed to minimize performance impact.

Does BotSieve send data to external servers?

No. All collected data remains on your WordPress installation.

What data is stored?

BotSieve stores request-related metadata such as URLs, hashed IP information, user agents and timestamps locally in your WordPress database.
